newsitem.title: USA: Cyclone still threat to shipping in Coral Sea.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone still threat to shipping in Coral Sea.

text.p: Tropical Cyclone Justin, with 65 mph winds, is in the Coral Sea, well east of Queensland, Australia, near 14s/151e, moving southwest at 10 mph, Weather Services corp said.
The cyclone should slowly weaken as it tracks towards the southwest and in 72 hours should be about 150 miles east of the Queensland coast with top winds of 50 mph.

This system will continue to threaten shipping in the Coral Sea during this period. Strong winds and rough seas will create problems at sea and high surf along the Queensland Coast. It may eventually threaten the Queensland coast beyond the 72 hour period but it is still too early to tell, WSC added.
